subject: Vendor onboarding: PO templates, wiring info, and onboarding forms for Acme Retail
messages:
From: Liam O'Neal <liam.oneal@acme-retail.com>
To: camila_reyes@redwood.ai
Date: 2025-09-18 09:12 -0700
Subject: Redwood listing - vendor onboarding & PO flow

Hi Camila,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. We're ready to move forward with listing Redwood on Acme's marketplace. Procurement asked me to collect your vendor setup packet so our finance team can issue the first PO.

Can you send: 
- Vendor onboarding form (bank wiring + tax)
- Your standard PO template or instructions for how we should originate the PO
- Any carrier/payment terms (net30/45) and remit address for invoices

Primary contacts on our side: 
- Liam O'Neal (liam.oneal@acme-retail.com) - Procurement lead
- Priya Kapoor (priya.kapoor@acme-retail.com) - Finance/accounts payable

Target go-live: mid-October if paperwork looks good.

Thanks,
Liam
Procurement | Acme Retail
From: camila_reyes@redwood.ai <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Neal <liam.oneal@acme-retail.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: 2025-09-18 11:03 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood listing - vendor onboarding & PO flow

Hi Liam — thanks, happy to get this moving. Attached is our vendor_setup_form.xlsx (bank wiring, tax, ACH remit). A few quick notes: 

- Billing name: Redwood Inference, Inc.
- Tax ID (EIN): 12-3456789 (we can provide a W-9 if you need formal tax docs)
- Standard terms: Net 30 unless a different term is requested and signed

Next steps I recommend:
1) Fill out the attached vendor form and return with the signed W-9 (if Acme requires one).
2) We'll circulate our PO template internally and confirm the remit address and signatory.
3) If Acme needs specific invoicing metadata (HubSpot/PO number format), send an example and we will conform.

I'll loop in Vanessa (finops) and Kimberly (legal) for PO questions and any contract redlines.

Attachments: vendor_setup_form.xlsx (fields: bank_name, acct_type, remit_address, tax_id, primary_contact)

Best,
Camila Reyes
Seller Operations | Redwood Inference
camila_reyes@redwood.ai
From: Priya Kapoor <priya.kapoor@acme-retail.com>
To: camila_reyes@redwood.ai
Cc: Liam O'Neal <liam.oneal@acme-retail.com>
Date: 2025-09-18 14:21 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood listing - vendor onboarding & PO flow

Hi Camila — attaching the completed vendor form plus our signed W-9. Quick answers inline: 
- Invoice remit address: Accounts Payable, Acme Retail, 400 Commerce St, Seattle, WA 98101
- PO signer: department head (we'll route the PV to Procurement, should be signed within 48 hours)

Attachments: acme_signed_w9.pdf, completed_vendor_form.xlsx (filled)

Can you confirm Redwood's preferred invoice email and whether invoices must include a specific cost-center code?

Thanks,
Priya Kapoor
AP Manager | Acme Retail
From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Kapoor <priya.kapoor@acme-retail.com>, Liam O'Neal <liam.oneal@acme-retail.com>
Cc: camila_reyes@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Date: 2025-09-19 08:45 -0700
Subject: Redwood PO template and remit/invoice guidance

Hi Priya / Liam — welcome aboard. Attaching our Redwood PO template (redwood_acme_po_template.pdf). A couple of items for your team to confirm so finance can route the PO cleanly:

- Remit address for checks (if needed): Redwood Inference, Inc., 88 Tech Way, Suite 210, San Francisco, CA 94107
- Preferred invoicing: PDF invoices emailed to invoices@redwood.ai; include PO number in the subject line and line-item unit prices; we accept electronic invoicing via SFTP or AP portals as needed
- Payment terms we can accept: Net 30 (standard); Net 45 by exception for larger enterprise arrangements
- Currency: USD; taxes handled by Acme per local rules

If Acme needs us to accept a different PO numbering schema, provide a sample PO and we'll make sure invoice matching works.

Attachments: redwood_acme_po_template.pdf (stub)

Ben — can you confirm tax-ops note about withholding or VAT exposures? Kimberly, FYI on PO language (we default to our master services terms unless there are material redlines).

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Finance Operations | Redwood Inference
From: ben_carter@redwood.ai <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: camila_reyes@redwood.ai, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Date: 2025-09-19 09:22 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood PO template and remit/invoice guidance

Looping in quick payment-term guidance: 
- Standard Net 30; we can accept Net 45 for strategic marketplace commitments with a recorded exception.
- ACH details are in the vendor_setup_form.xlsx; wire instructions require a signed PO and an invoice referencing the PO.
- No VAT on Redwood invoices (US entity); if Acme requires VAT handling for EU customers, we can discuss a pass-through arrangement.

On the legal side, Kimberly — any flags on Acme's requested terms in their procurement note?

—Ben
From: Liam O'Neal <liam.oneal@acme-retail.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, camila_reyes@redwood.ai
Cc: Priya Kapoor <priya.kapoor@acme-retail.com>
Date: 2025-09-20 10:05 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood PO template and remit/invoice guidance

Thanks everyone — confirmed. A couple quick items before we issue the PO tomorrow: 
- Invoice email confirmed: invoices@redwood.ai
- PO signer: Procurement head (we'll route for signature today)
- Cost-center: please place code ACME-CLOUD-MKT on the invoice for internal routing

We'll send the signed PO via DocuSign (link will come from our system). Expected delivery: within 24 hours. Looking forward to the go-live window mid-October.

Best,
Liam
Procurement | Acme Retail
